text: On Olson's animalism, a brain transplant carries the person along with the transplanted brain, because the person is essentially the psychology that the brain implements.
explanation: This is false. Animalism holds that you are the human organism, so in a brain transplant you remain with the (now brain-damaged) original body, while the recipient body is not you. The claim that the person 'goes with the brain' is the widespread intuition that animalism is charged with violating — the brain-transplant objection — not what animalism itself asserts.
